description:
Demolition of existing buildings; erection of part single and part three storey building for Class E use together with ancillary structures and landscaping 
(as part of a phased development)
decision_conditions:
<p class="paragraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:33.15pt;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:0cm">The proposal, by reason of the
requirement to remove the existing trees on site, in combination with the lack
of a satisfactory ecological and habitat survey and accompanying biodiversity net gain proposal, has failed
to demonstrate that a satisfactory net biodiversity uplift would be
provided, contrary to&nbsp;the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024),&nbsp;Policy G6 of the London Plan and Policy GI3 of the
Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p class="paragraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:33.15pt;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:0cm"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The submitted
information relating to surface water and foul drainage and flood risk
mitigation relates to a different development than proposed under this application.
As such, insufficient information has been submitted to allow the Local
Planning Authority to determine the acceptability of the proposal with regard
to drainage matters, including foul and surface water drainage, contrary to
Policies SI 12 and SI 13 of The London Plan (2021) and Strategic Policy 08,
CN3, and CN4 of the Harrow Local Plan </span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">
&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="paragraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:33.15pt;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:0cm"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The proposal,
by reason of its unsatisfactory and unsecure cycle storage and waste storage,
and failure to demonstrate satisfactory arrangements have been made for waste and
other serving and deliveries, or for construction access, would therefore be likely
to result in undue nuisance and obstruction of traffic and pedestrian on public
and/or private roads, highways safety impacts, a lack of safe and secure cycle and
waste storage, and it would fail to support a shift to sustainable transportation
modes. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D11, T4, T5 and T7.G of
the London Plan (2021) and Policies GR3B, LE1.C, CE1, M2 and M3 of the Harrow
Local Plan </span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"> &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="paragraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:33.15pt;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:0cm"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Insufficient
information has been provided with regard to proposed landscaping to allow the
Local Planning Authority to accurately assess the proposal with regard to the
extent of landscaping works to be undertaken, and the character and appearance of
the proposed site layout, contrary to Policy D3 of The London Plan 2021 and
Policies GR1 and GI4.I of the Harrow Local Plan </span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"> &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="paragraph" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:33.15pt;margin-bottom:
0cm;margin-left:0cm"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The proposal,
by reason of the lack of a satisfactory Fire Safety Statement, has failed to
demonstrate satisfactory arrangements for fire safety, to the detriment of the
safety of future and neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Policy D12.A of The
London Plan (2021) and Policy GR3B.C of the Harrow Local Plan </span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">(2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"> &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p>
